title: Structure of a First Java Program
description: Read a first Java program with a class, main method, single-line comment, and two System.out.println calls.

steps.description: Wrap the program in public class Main and define public static void main(String[] args) inside matching curly braces.
Read the single-line comment starting with // on line 3, followed by two System.out.println statements on lines 4 and 5.

steps.question: Does the // line on line 3 appear in the program output when the code runs?
steps.answer: No; // starts a comment for human readers that the Java compiler ignores, so only lines 4 and 5 print.

steps.description: Notice how execution starts directly at line 4, skipping the comment on line 3, to print 'Hello World!' and 'Have a great day.'.
